mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases for 2 consecutive months, and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.
